name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** An amount of ₹6,000/- per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000/- every four months is provided to each eligible family.
_eligibility_text: - All landholding farmers' families, which have cultivable land holding in their names are eligible to get benefit under the scheme.
